title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Thursday, 22 October 2026
description: Anthropic's draft IPO prospectus reveals explosive revenue growth alongside an $80.7 billion six-month loss, the RACGP welcomes an expansion of rural GP training places, Queensland commits $30 million to a second round of grassroots sport funding, and the Gold Coast steps up its e-bike compliance crackdown. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
